changes: New: TRIG + SCENE. In grid recording, hold one or more trigs and press SCENE A, SCENE B or both; when you let go of the last scene key, the scene's locked values (or the crossfader's current blend) become p-locks on the held steps of the active track. Requested by an MK1 user on Discord.

One scene writes every value it locks, replacing a p-lock the step already had for that parameter and leaving the step's other p-locks alone; the blend writes what each step plays at the current fader position, using the step's own p-lock where it has one. Slots the page lacks are skipped and values stay inside each parameter's range, as stock's own p-lock writer does; the held trigs stay. Toasts: SCENE A TO TRIGS, SCENE B TO TRIGS, SCENE BLEND TO TRIGS, or NOTHING TO LOCK.

Stock gestures inside the chord keep their meaning: a trig pressed while the scene key is held selects a scene and a knob turned writes a scene lock, and then no p-lock is written. SCENE first, then a trig, still selects a scene. There is no undo; hold the trig and press PLAY (stock) to clear that step's p-locks.
Two new patch sites: the entries of stock's SCENE press and release handlers. The Part apply (SCENE + YES) is unchanged.
Tested under ot_emu only (verify.py). TRIG + SCENE has not run on hardware, on the MKII or the MK1; the card build was not run on hardware for this version.
New module: hold SCENE A or SCENE B and press YES to write that scene's locked values into the active Part; hold both to write the current crossfader blend.
Covers SRC page 1, LFO speed and depth, AMP, FX1 and FX2 on all eight audio tracks. XVOL, XLV, trig locks and LFO modulation are not written.
Scenes, mutes, the crossfader and the saved Part stay unchanged, so RELOAD PART (FUNC + CUE) undoes an apply. NOTHING TO APPLY means no value would change.
YES with a scene key held no longer shows ARM ALL; YES alone still does. A parameter locked in only one scene can sound different after an apply.
Documentation only: the module page credits the author as Nathaniel Pavel (GitHub @npp1993).
